subject.description: An original Minecraft-native wingless Chinese dragon boss in a neutral flying pose, with sixteen continuous serpentine segments, four eagle-clawed legs, branching deer antlers, lion mane, catfish beard, long whiskers, and a tapered flame tail.
uncertainties: The direct concept is a side-dominant view; hidden-side geometry is mirrored conservatively.
Dynamic coil curvature and the attack pearl are animation/effect states, not static geometry.

generation.authoring: Original deterministic cuboid reconstruction from project concept art

source_references.title: Eleven Dragons
